idea-plugin.name: SS14 Studio
idea-plugin.description:
SS14 Studio is an all-in-one Space Station 14 development companion for JetBrains Rider.

  • Interactive construction graph viewer with entity sprites, edge steps, path highlighting, minimap and layout persistence.
  • YAML prototype explorer with inheritance trees, resolved components, value provenance, partial-prototype effects and an approximate in-game inspector card.
  • RobustToolbox XAML tooling: validation, completion, navigation, outline, an approximate visual designer, formatting and before/after diffs.
  • RSI sprite studio: animation playback, directions, frame delays, metadata, PNG import/replace, cleanup and a pixel editor.
  • Diff and merge-conflict review, plus editor actions and a status bar summary.

The plugin keeps Rider's native editors as the default. Studio surfaces open only when you ask for them, through the tool window, editor actions or the status bar.

AI disclosure: this plugin and its shared web UI were generated with AI assistance and are reviewed by human maintainers. See the AI-GENERATED.md file in the source repository for details.

Requirements: Node.js 18 or newer on PATH, or configure its location in Settings | Tools | SS14 Studio. The plugin serves its UI over a loopback HTTP server and displays it in JCEF.
